items.title: Halliburton (HAL) Signed Venezuela Oil And Gas Revival Agreements
items.summary: Halliburton (NYSE:HAL) has signed memorandums of understanding with Eneva and WESCA to work on Venezuela's oil and gas sector. The agreements outline cooperation on reviving and developing Venezuelan fields, supporting drilling, services, and related energy infrastructure projects. The MOUs align with recent policy moves that encourage fresh foreign energy investment into Venezuela's hydrocarbons industry. items.title: 2 Energy Stocks Worth Investigating and 1 We Find Risky
items.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, energy businesses are the backbone of our country, providing the energy we need to power our lives and businesses.But they are at the whim of volatile macroeconomic factors that influence capital spending (like interest rates and commodity prices), and the market seems convinced that demand will slow. Due to this bearish outlook, the industry has tumbled by 2.4% over the past six months. This performance is a stark contrast from the S&P 500’s 18.4% gain.
